description: Have PrintStudio design a print item from ONE sentence — 'flyer for our autumn fair on 3 October, free entry'. It writes the texts in fitting length, picks template and colour scheme and saves. Pass every fact that should be on it. Uses the AI quota and REPLACES the current design of this print item. If numbers_to_check is not empty, show those numbers to the user: they are neither in the sentence nor in the brand. An own QR code (qr in own_fields) is kept from before: ask whether it still fits the new content.

brief.description: What it is about, in the user's language (3–600 characters).

kind.description: business_card, letterhead, flyer (A5) or folder (A4, tri-fold).
